decisions.summary: The approved 45-bar edition writes each source span once.
decisions.source_basis: All seven source rows map in manuscript order; no whole-bar ditto signs or extra music after the D.C. instruction are present.
decisions.adopted_edition: All assignments are primary. The 132 performed visits are playback expansion, not written return copies or editorial inserted bars.

works.source_vs_edition_route: The manuscript shows an introduction before the A repeat, numbered endings in row 5, a B repeat junction and final D.C. lettering. Its degraded suffix and loose bracket lengths do not fully specify the performance. The saved human-approved edition supplies the explicit order I-A-E-A-B-C-B-C-I-A-B-C: I=1, A=2-28, E=29, B=30, C=31-45. B/C are technical splits of musical B. This produces 132 performed bars and stops at 45. The final D.C. includes intro, A second ending and B once, without repeats. This accepted route is not a new claim about missing ink.

limitations: Source identities and boundaries were visually inspected by a model on consumed material; independent verification remains separate.
Approximate x bounds are review locators on page-1.png at 180 dpi, not calibrated segmentation ground truth.
Accepted reconstructions and unresolved source ink remain separate from the source-bar identity.
